task_label: Extract the bounded M6.3 OpenAI ToolLoopRunner behind a default-off flag
problem_statement: OpenAIGateway currently owns the complete tool loop. The approved M6.3 slice must introduce a reusable provider-neutral ToolLoopRunner while retaining the existing OpenAI path by default and preserving gateway-only synthesis, fallback, and persistence behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Flag-off preserves the existing OpenAI loop.
Flag-on routes the declared provider-neutral responsibilities through ToolLoopRunner.
Gateway-only forced fallback, synthesis, routing guards, link repair, response shaping, and persistence stay outside the runner.
No Gemini, streaming, transport, resolver, OAuth, OpenRouter product, ToolCallAdapter, provider-policy, or Git work.
cursor_prompt_contract: Inspect and edit only allowlisted files. Implement the one bounded M6.3 ToolLoopRunner extraction, run only the listed checks, do not commit, and return concise JSON-compatible output.
